book.name: Ruuka
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Ruuka

content: Ekerenjo chɨ ɨngʼʉndu yɨnʉ yaabhurirɨ
Rusikʉ rʉmwɨ, abharihya bha rigʉʉti na bhʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ, bhaarɨ bhariisukɨra Yɨɨsu, bhamwitegeerere.
Ɨkagirya Abhafarisaayo na abhiija bhi imigirʉ, bhakiibheerya bharabhuga, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ, ndora arabhaginihya bhʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ! Naatu ararya nabhʉ!”
Neho Yɨɨsu akabhaha ekerenjo, akabhuga,
“Awɨɨ, wʉmwɨ waanyu ana zɨngʼʉndu igana rɨmwɨ. Araangʼurɨ ɨyɨmwɨ yaho ibhurirɨ, arakorabhwɨ? Atakuzitiga merongo kenda na kenda mukiriishʉ, na kuja komohya yɨnʉ ibhurirɨ, kuhika ayebhone?
Hanʉ araayebhone, arayegega kʉmabhega kwa bhozomerwa.
Hanʉ araahikɨ yɨɨka, arabhabhɨrɨkɨra abhasaani bhaazɨ na bhanyarʉbhɨri na kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra, ‘Tozomerwe hamwɨmwɨ, kʉ kʉbha ɨngʼʉndu yaanɨ yɨnʉ yaabhurirɨ, niyibhwɨnɨ!’

“Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, muyo nɨmbu kʉraabhɨ no obhozomerwa bhwaru mwisaarʉ, hanʉ ʉmʉkʉri wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ wʉmwɨ araatigɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwazɨ. Obhozomerwa bhuyo bhʉrabha bhʉkʉrʉ kʉkɨra bhwa abhaatʉ abhazʉmu merongo kenda na kenda bhanʉ bhataana ebhoono yu ukwichʉra.
Ekerenjo cha zimpirya zɨnʉ zaabhurirɨ
“Mwitegeerere ekerenjo ɨkɨndɨ. Ʉmʉkari wʉmwɨ ana amazenzere
ikumi, na araabhuryɨ rɨmwɨ arakorabhwɨ? Atakugwatya ɨkɨmʉrɨ, na kʉtaricha inyumba yʉʉsi na komohya kwa managa kuhika ayebhone?
Hanʉ araayebhone, arabhabhɨrɨkɨra abhasaani bhaazɨ na bhanyarʉbhɨri, na kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra, ‘Tozomerwe hamwɨmwɨ, kʉ kʉbha impirya yaanɨ, yɨnʉ yaabhurirɨ, niyibhwɨnɨ!’
“Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, nɨmbu Mungu akozomerwa mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa bhamaraika,
igʉrʉ wa wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ wʉmwɨ araatigɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwazɨ.”
Ekerenjo chu umumura wʉnʉ aasabhirɨ ɨgabhʉ
Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kʉgamba, “Kwarɨ nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ, aarɨ na abhaana bhabhɨrɨ bhi ikisubhɨ.
Umusuuhu, akabhʉʉrɨra wiisɨ, ‘Bhaabha, ongʼe ɨgabhʉ yaanɨ.’ Wiisɨ akabhasondya ebhegero bhyazɨ.
“Zɨkahɨta sikʉ suuhu, umusuuhu wuyo akakumɨnga ebhegero bhyazɨ bhyʉsi, akakora orogendo akaja icharʉ cha kore. Hanʉ aahikirɨ iyo, akarya ebhegero bhyazɨ kɨbhɨ.
Hanʉ aamarirɨ ebhegero bhyazɨ bhyʉsi, ɨnzara ɨhaari ɨkahʉrʉka mucharʉ kirya, akatanga kʉnyaaka.
“Neho akaja kʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ wa mʉʉsɨ yirya, akamʉsabha abhɨ omohocha waazɨ. Ʉmʉʉtʉ wurya akamʉtʉma mʉmʉgʉndʉ kuriisha zingurubhɨ
zaazɨ.
Hanʉ zingurubhɨ zaarɨ zɨrarya amakoko, akabha ariigomba wʉʉsi kʉgarya. Nawe atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aamʉhɨɨrɨ chʉchʉsi chu ukurya.
“Ɨtɨnɨrʉ, akatanga kobhona amangʼɨɨni, akiigambɨra, ‘Ndora abhahocha bha bhaabha, bhʉʉsi bhararya, kuhika bhariigʉta na kʉsaaja. Nawe inyɨ, nɨrakwa nɨ ɨnzara.
Nɨragarʉka kwa bhaabha na kʉmʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Bhaabha, nɨsariryɨ igʉrʉ wa Mungu, na nɨkʉsaririiryɨ.
Nɨtakwenderwa naatu kubhirikirwa umwana waazʉ. Onkore nɨbhɨ wʉmwɨ wa abhahocha bhaazʉ.” ’

“Akʉmara umumura wuyo, akarwa hayo, akagarʉka kwa wiisɨ. Hanʉ aarɨ akɨɨrɨ kore ni inyumba, wiisɨ akamorora, umwʉyʉ gwazɨ gukiizʉra ɨbhɨgʉngi. Rogendo rʉmwɨ akaryarɨra umwana waazɨ, akamugwɨra kukikubha na kumuhumbata.
Umumura wuyo, akabhʉʉrɨra wiisɨ, ‘Bhaabha, nɨsariiryɨ Mungu, na nɨkʉsaririiryɨ. Nɨtakwenderwa kubhirikirwa mwana waazʉ naatu.’
“Nawe, wiisɨ akabhʉʉrɨra abhahocha bhaazɨ, ‘Moreete bhwangʉ, zengebho zɨnzʉmu, mumwibhohyɨ! Mumwibhohyɨ epete kuchara chazɨ, ni ibhikwɨra kʉmagʉrʉ.
Moreete ikihiiri ikinuru kirya, mʉsɨnzɨ. Tokore ɨnyangi, tozomerwe hamwɨmwɨ,
kʉ kʉbha umwana waanɨ, aarɨ abhurirɨ, nawe nangʉ abhʉnɨkirɨ, aarɨ nkina akuurɨ, nawe nangʉ mʉhʉru naatu!’ Neho bhayo bhʉʉsi bhakatanga kozomerwa.
“Ribhaga riyo, umwana waazɨ ʉmʉkʉrʉ aarɨ mʉmʉgʉndʉ. Hanʉ aarɨ akʉgarʉka na akwisemera yɨɨka, akiigwa abhaatʉ bharɨɨmba na kubhina.
Akabhɨrɨkɨra omohocha wʉmwɨ, akamubhuurya, ‘Kʉnakɨ?’
“Akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, ‘Umusuuhu waazʉ iizirɨ, na bhaabha amusinziirɨ ikihiiri ikinuru, kʉ kʉbha amubhwɨnɨ umwana waazɨ, akɨɨrɨ mʉhʉru.’
“Umwana ʉmʉkʉrʉ akiigatana, akaanga kusikɨra yɨɨka. Wiisɨ akahʉrʉka igʉtʉ, akabha aramwisasaama asikɨrɨ.

Nawe, akamʉgarukirya, ‘Itegeerera! Imyaka myaru nɨbhɨɨrɨ nɨrakohokerya, na nɨkɨɨrɨ kutiga kwitegeerera amaragɨrɨra gaazʉ nʉʉrʉ rogendo rʉmwɨ! Nawe, inyɨ ʉkɨɨrɨ kongʼa nʉʉrʉ ekenena chi imburi, nekore ɨnyangi hamwɨmwɨ na abhasaani bhaanɨ.
Nawe umwana waazʉ wʉnʉ ariirɨ ebhegero bhyazʉ na abhasimbɨ, hanʉ ahikirɨbhu, umusinziirɨ ikihiiri!’
“Wiisɨ akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, ‘Mwana waanɨ, awɨ ʉrɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ sikʉ zʉʉsi, ne ebhegero bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ nɨnabhyʉ ni‑bhyazʉ.
Nawe umusuuhu waazʉ, itwɨndirɨ tomokorere ɨnyangi na kozomerwa hamwɨmwɨ, kʉ kʉbha aarɨ abhurirɨ, nawe nangʉ abhʉnɨkirɨ, na aarɨ nkina akuurɨ, nawe nangʉ mʉhʉru!’ ”

footnotes.text: Amazenzere kuKigiriki nɨ‑darakima. Darakima yɨmwɨ yaarɨ amarihi go omohocha kurusikʉ rʉmwɨ.
Nɨmbu Mungu akozomerwa mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa bhamaraika, ʉbhʉgaruri ʉbhʉndɨ bhʉratʉra kʉbha, bhoreho obhozomerwa mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa bhamaraika bha Mungu.
